text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O continues her training 
to obtain the speed needed to overwhelm 
Nishino Flower.

She reasonably suspects that her Trainer 
might be trying to turn her into a 
sprinter... but still!

Having decided to believe in her Trainer, 
Sakura Bakushin O shakes off all doubt and 
charges ahead! For victory!!
